#PERMANOVA: Enclousure type and Spp.
```{r}

## 4. PERMANOVA: 2 variables 
meta.st <- data.frame(sample_data(phy.rar))

# Complete model with interaction
permanova.completo <- adonis2(t(otu_table(phy.rar)) ~ TipoRecinto * Especie,
                              data = meta.st,
                              permutations = 999,
                              method = "bray",
                              by = "margin")  # Marginal effects 

# Additive model (no interaction)
permanova.aditivo <- adonis2(t(otu_table(phy.rar)) ~ TipoRecinto + Especie,
                             data = meta.st,
                             permutations = 999,
                             method = "bray")

## 5. Results visualization
cat("\nResultados PERMANOVA (efectos marginales):\n")
print(permanova.completo)

cat("\nResultados PERMANOVA (modelo aditivo):\n")
print(permanova.aditivo)

## 6. Save results 
sink("./Plots/permanova_resultados.txt")
cat("=== PERMANOVA - Efectos Marginales ===\n")
print(permanova.completo)
cat("\n=== PERMANOVA - Modelo Aditivo ===\n")
print(permanova.aditivo)
sink()
```


```{r}

permanova.interactivo <- adonis2(
  formula = t(otu_table(phy.rar)) ~ TipoRecinto * Especie,
  data = meta.st,
  permutations = 999,
  method = "bray",
  by = NULL        
)

print(permanova.interactivo)
```

###Plot: Encolousure Type and Spp.

```{r}
        data = meta.st,

        method = "bray",

```

### PERMANOVA: Individual factor and interacction

```{r}
adonis2(t(otu_table(phy.rar)) ~ Alimentacion * Especie * TipoRecinto,
        data = meta.st,
        permutations = 999,
        method = "bray",
        by = "terms")  

```

```{r}
## Dispersal Analysis
dispersion <- list(
  Especie = betadisper(vegdist(t(otu_table(phy.all))), meta.all$Especie),
  Alimentacion = betadisper(vegdist(t(otu_table(phy.all))), meta.all$Alimentacion),
  TipoRecinto = betadisper(vegdist(t(otu_table(phy.all))), meta.all$TipoRecinto)
)

sink("./Plots/dispersion_todas_especies.txt")
cat("=== Homogeneidad de varianzas ===\n")
lapply(dispersion, function(x) {
  cat("\n")
  print(anova(x))
})
sink()
```

# PCoA Unifrac weighted and unweighted by Spp.

```{r}
# Weighted matrix by spp.

Unif <- microbiome::transform(phy.rar, "compositional")
UnifU <- ordinate(Unif, "PCoA", "unifrac", weighted = TRUE)
```


```{r}
#PERMANOVA Ponderate Matrix by Spp
# load libraries
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(microbiome)

# Transform to compositional (normalization)
Unif <- microbiome::transform(phy.rar, "compositional")

# Obtain Unifrac weighted distances matrix 
dist_unif_weighted <- phyloseq::distance(Unif, method = "unifrac", weighted = TRUE)

# Extract metadata
metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(Unif))

# PERMANOVA adonis2 (999 permutations)
permanova_result <- adonis2(dist_unif_weighted ~ Especie, data = metadata)

# Show results
print(permanova_result)

```

```{r}
#UnWeighted matrix by Spp.

Unif <- microbiome::transform(phy.rar, "compositional")
UnifU <- ordinate(Unif, "PCoA", "unifrac", weighted = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#PERMANOVA UnWeighted matrix by Spp.
# load libraries
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(microbiome)

# Transform to compositional (normalization)
Unif <- microbiome::transform(phy.rar, "compositional")

# Obtain Unifrac Unweighted distances matrix 
dist_unif_unweighted <- phyloseq::distance(Unif, method = "unifrac", weighted = FALSE)

# Extract metadata
metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(Unif))

# PERMANOVA adonis2 (999 permutations)
permanova_result_unweighted <- adonis2(dist_unif_unweighted ~ Especie, data = metadata)

# Show results
print(permanova_result_unweighted)

```



```{r}
#Create function: Paired PERMANOVA
#For weighted distance

run_pairwise_permanova <- function(physeq_obj, species1, species2) {
  # Obain metadata
  meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_obj))
  
  # Filtrate 2 spp.
  keep_samples <- rownames(meta[meta$Especie %in% c(species1, species2), ])
  
  # Subset phyloseq object  
  phy_pair <- prune_samples(keep_samples, physeq_obj)
  
  # Transform to compositional
  phy_pair_comp <- microbiome::transform(phy_pair, "compositional")
  
  # Calculate  UniFrac weihgted distance
  dist_matrix <- phyloseq::distance(phy_pair_comp, method = "unifrac", weighted = TRUE)
  
  # Extract metadata
  metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_pair_comp))
  
  # Run PERMANOVA
  result <- adonis2(dist_matrix ~ Especie, data = metadata)
  
  # print results
  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("Comparación:", species1, "vs", species2, "\n")
  print(result)
  cat("==============================\n")
}


```

```{r}
# Specific comparations
run_pairwise_permanova(Unif, "Alouatta pigra", "Alouatta palliata")
run_pairwise_permanova(Unif, "Alouatta pigra", "Ateles geoffroyi")
run_pairwise_permanova(Unif, "Alouatta palliata", "Ateles geoffroyi")

```


```{r}
#Create function: Paired PERMANOVA
#For Unweighted distance

run_pairwise_permanova <- function(physeq_obj, species1, species2) {
 
  # Obain metadata
  meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_obj))
  
# Filtrate 2 spp.
  keep_samples <- rownames(meta[meta$Especie %in% c(species1, species2), ])
  
  # Subset phyloseq object  
  phy_pair <- prune_samples(keep_samples, physeq_obj)
  
# Transform to compositional
  phy_pair_comp <- microbiome::transform(phy_pair, "compositional")
  
 # Calculate  UniFrac weihgted distanc
  dist_matrix <- phyloseq::distance(phy_pair_comp, method = "unifrac", weighted = FALSE)
  
   # Extract metadata
  metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_pair_comp))
  
  # Run PERMANOVA
  result <- adonis2(dist_matrix ~ Especie, data = metadata)
  
  # print results
  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("Comparación:", species1, "vs", species2, "\n")
  print(result)
  cat("==============================\n")
}


```

```{r}
# Specific comparations
run_pairwise_permanova(Unif, "Alouatta pigra", "Alouatta palliata")
run_pairwise_permanova(Unif, "Alouatta pigra", "Ateles geoffroyi")
run_pairwise_permanova(Unif, "Alouatta palliata", "Ateles geoffroyi")

```

#PCoA: ***Ateles geoffroyi***

```{r eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Load libraries
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)
library(MetBrewer)
library(ggpubr)  # Para combinar gráficos

## 1. Filtrate:  Ateles geoffroyi 
phy.ateles <- subset_samples(phy.rar, Especie == "Ateles geoffroyi")

## 2. Calculate PCoA
pcoa.ateles  <- ordinate(phy.ateles, "PCoA", "bray")
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

## 6. PERMANOVA for two variables: enclousure type and diet
meta.ateles <- data.frame(sample_data(phy.ateles))

# Interaction model
permanova.full <- adonis2(t(otu_table(phy.ateles)) ~ Alimentacion * TipoRecinto,
                          data = meta.ateles,
                          permutations = 999,
                          method = "bray")

# Additive model
permanova.add <- adonis2(t(otu_table(phy.ateles)) ~ Alimentacion + TipoRecinto,
                         data = meta.ateles,
                         permutations = 999,
                         method = "bray")

# Save 
sink("./Plots/permanova_resultados.txt")
cat("=== PERMANOVA - Modelo Completo (con interacción) ===\n")
print(permanova.full)
cat("\n=== PERMANOVA - Modelo Aditivo ===\n")
print(permanova.add)
sink()
```

# PCoA: ***Alouata palliata***

```{r eval=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# load libraries
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)
library(MetBrewer)
library(ggpubr)  

## 1. Filtrate: Alouatta palliata
phy.palliata <- subset_samples(phy.rar, Especie == "Alouatta palliata")

## 2. Calculate PCoA 
pcoa.palliata  <- ordinate(phy.palliata, "PCoA", "bray")
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

## PERMANOVA for two variables: enclousure type and diet
meta.palliata <- data.frame(sample_data(phy.palliata))

# Interaction Model
permanova.full <- adonis2(t(otu_table(phy.palliata)) ~ Alimentacion * TipoRecinto,
                          data = meta.palliata,
                          permutations = 999,
                          method = "bray")

# Additive model
permanova.add <- adonis2(t(otu_table(phy.palliata)) ~ Alimentacion + TipoRecinto,
                         data = meta.palliata,
                         permutations = 999,
                         method = "bray")

# Save results
sink("./Plots/permanova_resultados.txt")
cat("=== PERMANOVA - Modelo Completo (con interacción) ===\n")
print(permanova.full)
cat("\n=== PERMANOVA - Modelo Aditivo ===\n")
print(permanova.add)
sink()
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

## Dispersion analysis
disp.alim <- betadisper(vegdist(t(otu_table(phy.palliata))), meta.palliata$Alimentacion)
disp.recinto <- betadisper(vegdist(t(otu_table(phy.palliata))), meta.palliata$TipoRecinto)

# Save results
sink("./Plots/dispersión_resultados.txt")
cat("=== Homogeneidad de varianzas - Alimentación ===\n")
print(anova(disp.alim))
cat("\n=== Homogeneidad de varianzas - TipoRecinto ===\n")
print(anova(disp.recinto))
sink()
```
